name: Clerk Authentication
description: User authentication and session management via Clerk. Provides middleware for protecting routes and user identity.

dbTables.name: users
dbTables.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, clerk_id TEXT UNIQUE, email TEXT, name TEXT, role TEXT DEFAULT 'user', avatar_url TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_clerk ON users(clerk_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_email ON users(email)

routes.description: Clerk webhook handler for user events

webhooks.description: Sync Clerk user changes to D1
